limitations.note: The rewrite registers the newly computed count directly instead of registering the previous value of `num`, so `number` still shows each increment or load one edge earlier than expected.
The rewrite also advances `zero` by an edge, replacing the original registered comparison of `num` that the correct fix preserves.
The test expects each increment or load to appear on the same edge that processes it, so its passing result cannot validate the required one-edge output delay.
